title: World’s Best Speakers!
summary: Tech Ingredients shows how to build flat panel speakers from exciters and foam board, with construction guidelines, measured SPL comparisons and a complete system playing music.
why: HN commenters point to it as a build guide for cheap DIY speakers that sound as good as expensive ones.

quote.text: I built my own speakers for under $200 and I honestly think they are some of the best I've ever heard for a personal setup.
